subject: general
question: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) came into effect on 15 August. Identify the year,
solution:
The correct answer is __**1995**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) came into effect on **15 August, 1995**.
 
• **Announcement**: The program was announced by the Prime Minister on July 28, 1995.
 
• **Purpose**: Launched to provide social assistance to poor households in cases of old age, death of the breadwinner, and maternity.
 
• **Implementation**: The NSAP is implemented in both urban and rural areas across all states and union territories in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Schemes under NSAP**:

 
 
• Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
 
• Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
 
• Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
 
• National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
 
• Annapurna Scheme
